units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:18">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 4</cite> <he>אם תאמר כמ׳ שבבקעה וכ׳</he> you might think ‘like the chaff’ in the valley in which there is yet some moisture &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end <he>התבן והקש והמ׳ וכ׳</he> the straw, the stubble and the chaff were disputing with one another.
Midr. Till. to Ps. II; a. e.—[Tosef. Ter. III, 17 מן המ׳ ed. Zuck. from the grain before it is threshed; v., however, עֲרֵימָה.]
